claims.text: The hotel is at 21 East Bellevue Place on Chicago's Gold Coast, a short stroll from Oak Street's boutiques, the Magnificent Mile and Oak Street Beach on Lake Michigan.

findings.quote: 21 East Bellevue Place, Chicago, IL 60611
takes center stage on the iconic Gold Coast. A short stroll from our boutique hotel, discover Oak Street’s trendy boutiques, the Magnificent Mile and the beauty of Lake Michigan at Oak Street Beach.

claims.text: Rooms and suites have 400-thread-count Sferra linens, rainfall showers, mid-century modern furnishings and artwork.

findings.quote: featuring 400-thread count Sferra linens, rainfall showers, mid-century modern furnishings and inspired artwork

claims.text: Select rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Lake Michigan, tree-lined streets and the Magnificent Mile.

findings.quote: Select rooms and suites at our Gold Coast hotel boast floor-to-ceiling windows so you can wake up to glittering views of Lake Michigan, tree-lined downtown streets, the Magnificent Mile and more.

claims.text: The Thompson Suite has in-room fitness amenities, including a Peloton bike and free weights.

findings.quote: Book a Thompson Suite and enjoy in-room fitness amenities including a Peloton bike and free weights.

claims.text: Tavern on Rush is the hotel's flagship restaurant and bar, serving steak and seafood.

findings.quote: Discover some of downtown Chicago’s finest steak and seafood at our hotel’s flagship restaurant and bar, Tavern on Rush.

claims.text: Tavern on Rush serves brunch on Saturdays and Sundays.

findings.quote:
Brunch

    - Sat & Sun

claims.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes, rowing machines, and cardio and strength equipment, and is available to guests around the clock.

findings.quote: complete with Peloton bikes, row machines, cardio and strength training equipment. Available to guests 24/7.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as sleek with organic accents that hint at a Prairie School architectural homage.

findings.quote:
Sleek with organic accents, it hints at

claims.text: Thompson Chicago is dog-friendly, though dogs cannot be left unattended in guest rooms.

findings.quote: Dog-friendly hotel. Dogs cannot be left unattended in guest rooms

claims.text: The nearest CTA station is Chicago/State on the Red Line.

findings.quote: The nearest CTA station to Thompson Chicago is the Chicago/State station. This station is served by the Red Line

claims.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance around the clock.

findings.quote: valet parking is available at the hotel entrance 24/7

claims.text: The two-story Penthouse Suites feature a billiards table and an outdoor terrace.

findings.quote: two-story Penthouse Suites, featuring a billiards table and a sprawling outdoor terrace

claims.text: The fourth-floor Froines Room lounge has a floor-to-ceiling half-moon window overlooking Bellevue Street.

findings.quote: overlooking Bellevue Street and downtown Chicago from our hotel’s moody, modern fourth-floor lounge known as the Froines Room, featuring a floor-to-ceiling half-moon window

claims.text: Tavern on Rush has multi-level seating, private dining, a bar and an outdoor patio on Rush Street.

findings.quote: This unique steakhouse features multi-level seating, private dining, a bustling bar and downtown Chicago's favorite outdoor patio on famous Rush Street.

claims.text: The Skyline Loft Suite with Terrace is bi-level, with a spiral staircase, a dining table for four and a private balcony terrace.

findings.quote: Discover peak Chicago living in this spacious bi-level loft suite with spectacular lake and city views on full display through floor-to-ceiling windows and the private balcony terrace.
features a focal spiral staircase, dining table for four

claims.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room; it covers perks such as a discount at the 360 Chicago Observation Deck and daily bottled water.

findings.quote: a daily destination fee of $25.00 (subject to change) will apply to each room of your stay
20% Discount to the 360 Chicago Observation Deck
